description: This file defines the NodeSearch class for Drupal, implementing search functionality for node entities using the Search module index. It includes methods for executing searches, indexing nodes, handling search form alterations, and managing search rankings.

classes.name: NodeSearch
classes.description: Handles searching for node entities using the Search module index, including executing searches, indexing nodes, and managing search configurations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate NodeSearch with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies and setting up the search plugin.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access content.

methods.name: isSearchExecutable
methods.description: Determines if a search can be executed based on keywords or parameters.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID as the search type.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the search and returns results or an empty array.

methods.name: findResults
methods.description: Builds and executes the search query, handling advanced filters and ranking, and sets status messages.

methods.name: prepareResults
methods.description: Prepares search results for rendering, including loading nodes and rendering snippets.

methods.name: removeSubmittedInfo
methods.description: Removes submitted by information from the node build array for snippets.

methods.name: addNodeRankings
methods.description: Adds ranking expressions to the search query based on configuration.

methods.name: updateIndex
methods.description: Indexes nodes, respecting the cron limit, and updates word weights.

methods.name: indexNode
methods.description: Indexes a single node, including rendering and extracting text for search.

methods.name: indexClear
methods.description: Clears the search index for nodes.

methods.name: markForReindex
methods.description: Marks nodes for reindexing.

methods.name: indexStatus
methods.description: Returns total and remaining nodes to index.

methods.name: searchFormAlter
methods.description: Alters the search form to include advanced options.

methods.name: buildSearchUrlQuery
methods.description: Builds URL query parameters from the search form state.

methods.name: parseAdvancedDefaults
methods.description: Parses default values for the advanced search form.

methods.name: getRankings
methods.description: Retrieves ranking definitions via hooks.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default plugin configuration.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for content ranking.

methods.name: submitConfigurationForm
methods.description: Handles submission of the ranking configuration form.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns list of trusted callback methods.
